manifest.description: Inline a private single-statement Java method into its call sites and delete the declaration. v1 supports return-expression and void-expression-statement bodies that only reference formal parameters.
when_to_use: collapse a thin private wrapper into its caller before re-splitting the cluster
remove a one-line helper that adds no value after a structural change
preparation pass for a god-method extraction — inline trivial helpers so the body is contiguous, then re-extract with cleaner seams
anti_patterns: do not use on non-private methods — v1 doesn't walk for callers across files; out of scope
do not use to inline methods that touch enclosing state — refuse on this/super/field/method calls is intentional
do not use to inline multi-statement helpers — single-statement bodies only in v1

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-inline-method. Charter: Inline a private single-statement Java method into its call sites.

Protocol:

1. Ground:
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}")

2. Confirm method is inlineable:
   - private
   - single-statement body
   - body references only formal parameters

3. Plan:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="inline_java_method",
                      deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source}}",
                      module_name="{{module_name}}",
                      impl_name="{{impl_name}}")

   Planner emits N inline edits (one per call site) + 1 declaration
   delete edit. Each call site's argument expressions are wrapped in
   parens before substitution for operator-precedence safety; the
   surrounding substituted body is also wrapped in parens when the
   call is in expression position.

4. Apply and compile-verify:
   bbox_refactor_apply(plan_path="<plan_path>", confirm=true)

5. Emit done note:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line: method inlined, call_sites_inlined=N>)

Strict refusal rules:
- Never inline non-private methods via this atom — use rename then visibility narrowing if you need to inline across files (or wait for v2).
- Never inline methods whose bodies touch enclosing state — the v1 planner refuses; do not work around with prompt-discipline.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source}} {{module_name}} {{impl_name}}
